summary: Remote-controlled shell/agent daemon pairs installer host with first-party cloud over WebRTC
details: @factiii/runner is a headless daemon that pairs the installer's machine with Factiii's web and mobile clients over WebRTC via api.factiii.com and lets the remote peer drive Claude/Codex agent CLIs and tmux sessions on the host. The capability is documented as the product and the control plane matches the publisher's domain. Pairing is gated by a JWT and an AES-256-GCM machine key stored under ~/.factiii-runner/, and the daemon starts on an explicit `factiii-runner start` invocation, with optional LaunchAgent/systemd/scheduled-task persistence at login. The package also bundles prebuilt frpc (fastreverseproxy) binaries for darwin/linux amd64/arm64 and ships a `factiii-expose <port>` skill that publishes arbitrary local ports as public, unauthenticated HTTPS URLs. The daemon stores a GitHub PAT and a OneDrive refresh token for its agent features; no bulk sweeps of ~/.aws, ~/.ssh, or process.env were observed and no secondary non-first-party control plane is present. Blast radius for a paired peer is full-host shell execution, and the frpc skill lets that peer place internal services on the public internet without authentication.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
